title: Controlplane + Routing + Auth — weekly handoff notes
content:
Meeting: Platform engineering weekly handoff (control plane / routing / auth / quotas)
Date: 2026-09-30
Facilitator: Aisha Patel
Attendees: Aisha P., Miguel S., Riley C., Priya N., Daniel W., Samir K.
Meeting length: 40m (standup + focused sync)

Purpose: Align cross-subteam work for next sprint window, surface blockers, and confirm who owns immediate mitigation runs for observed quota/routing regressions.

1) Quick wins / wins from last week
- Deployed incremental fix to auth token refresh: average token latency reduced from 62ms -> 28ms in staging (Miguel / PR 981).
- Routing policy A/B experiment #3 completed without customer-impacting errors; we collected per-route cold-start histograms.
- Quota exporter added a sticky-sample metric that improved anomaly detection for per-tenant bursts.

2) Incident / metrics recap (last 7 days)
- Observed 2 customer reports of unexpected 429s between 09/23–09/25. Root cause: misconfigured burst window for a new tenant (manual override created by support).
  - Impact window: 2.5 hours peak (09/24 03:15–05:45 UTC).
  - Actions taken: emergency rollback of tenant-specific override, temporary global soft-throttle applied.
- Control plane control loop error rate: increased +0.7% Wed->Thu after a leader-election flapping sequence on a single raft shard. That shard has been isolated for deeper analysis.

3) Component-specific notes
- Control plane (Riley / Daniel)
  - Leader-election flapping: replicated locally; hypothesis is that kernel-level interrupt latencies on the node caused delayed heartbeats. Next steps: repro with stress tester and collect perf counters (Daniel). Ticket: PLT-4583.
  - Config PR to add jitter to election timeout merged to staging; rolling to canary tomorrow 10/01.
  - Long-term: evaluate moving that shard to different instance family to avoid noisy-neighbor impact. Cost estimate needed from infra.

- Routing (Priya / Samir)
  - Canary for route prioritization policy B (favor low-latency GPU pools for premium customers) running at 8% traffic. Observed 12% reduction in p95 for premium routes; p99 unchanged.
  - Two anomalies: (a) when fallback triggered to CPU variant, tokens served had 7% higher CPU time due to a serialization mismatch; fix planned for 10/04. (b) a small memory leak in the local router agent on v1.4.2 — hotfix merged, applying to canary tonight.
  - A/B test metrics: per-route success rate, cold-start latency, failover frequency collected into new dashboard (link in linked_artifacts).

- Auth (Miguel)
  - Token rotation cadence: rolling deployment of short-lived refresh tokens (TTL 10m) in staging; production rollout targeted 10/07 pending key-management validation.
  - Post-rotation metrics: refresh traffic up by ~3% (due to shorter TTL), but net latency improved. Need to tune client SDK caching guidance to reduce extra refreshes.
  - Outstanding: KMS integration test failing on HSM-backed key store for one enterprise customer — blocked by external vendor support ticket. Owner: Miguel (vendor ticket #VND-1221).

- Quotas / Rate limiting (Aisha / Priya)
  - Root cause for earlier 429s traced to interactive override behavior in admin UI. Propose disabling manual override for tenants without a support flag. Action: PR to admin app (Aisha) targeted 10/02.
  - New per-tenant burst accounting prototype shipped to staging. Early feedback: accurately models short bursts and prevents false positives. Need to load-test at 5x baseline before prod-safeguard removal. Owner: Priya (load test: 10/05).

4) Blockers and asks
- Infra capacity request: control plane wants two new r6g.large instances in us-west-2 for ephemeral nodes to repro noisy neighbor conditions; cost approval needed from infra finance (Daniel to file ticket).
- Vendor: HSM key rotations failing for enterprise customer corp-92; awaiting vendor fix before we can roll short-lived tokens for that tenant. (Miguel)
- Observability: routing agent leak stack traces are verbose and hitting Sentry rate limits. Request: increase Sentry quota for platform team for 48 hours to capture full traces (Samir).

5) Decisions made
- Proceed with canary rollout of jittered election timeout to 4% traffic tomorrow; if no regressions in 24h, increase to 30% then full rollout. (Riley)
- Disable manual tenant-level quota override in admin UI by default; require a documented support flag and audit trail. (Aisha to PR admin app)
- Delay production-wide token TTL change for enterprise tenants until vendor HSM issue resolved. Scoped rollout will go ahead for non-HSM tenants on 10/07. (Miguel)

6) Action items (owner / due date / status)
- Daniel W.: create infra cost ticket for 2 ephemeral repro instances in us-west-2 (due 2026-10-01) [open]
- Riley C.: monitor canary for jittered election timeouts, report back with heartbeat stability metrics (due 2026-10-02) [in_progress]
- Priya N.: run 5x load-test for quota burst prototype and publish results (due 2026-10-05) [open]
- Aisha P.: PR to disable manual tenant quota override + add audit log (due 2026-10-02) [in_progress]
- Miguel S.: follow up with vendor on HSM ticket VND-1221 and update status in weekly vendor sync (due 2026-10-06) [open]
- Samir K.: increase Sentry quota request and collect full leak traces for routing agent (due 2026-10-01) [open]
- All: add regression test case for token rotation to the CI matrix (owners: auth + dx) (due 2026-10-08) [open]

7) Risks / notes for next week
- If the vendor HSM fix slips beyond 2026-10-10, we need a contingency for enterprise tenants (option: temporarily extend TTL to 30m for affected tenants with explicit notice).
- Routing memory leak hotfix must be verified in load before expanding canary; failure could increase p95 on high-traffic routes.
- Quota load test results may require backpressure adjustments across dedicated pools to avoid cascading throttles.

8) Parking lot / longer-term items (no immediate action this week)
- Evaluate alternate leader-election strategy (Raft tuning vs multi-master fallback) for noisy nodes.
- Premium tenant routing SLA: define hard latency SLO and automated compensation flow when miss occurs.
- Investigate a lightweight per-tenant simulation harness to exercise quota and routing combos in CI.

Next sync: 2026-10-07 (same time). Please update your action items on the ticket board and add any retrospective notes to the Confluence page linked above.

Notes captured by: Aisha Patel
If you were at the meeting and an item ownership is incorrect, please update the doc and ping in #platform-standup.
